what_i_see: Centre lies in diffuse, bluish outer light with a sharp SW edge, dotted with compact knots and a small diffuse clump slightly NE of centre. Bright galaxy light enters the top-right corner; red compact sources lie outside the diffuse region.
most_likely: Star-forming knots/HII complexes in the outer disc of LEDA 147307, whose centre is ~30" NNW, off-frame.
against_it: A small dwarf satellite superposed on the disc cannot be excluded from this cutout.
decisive_test: Wider Euclid field showing the whole of LEDA 147307; H-alpha or spectra of the knots at the galaxy's redshift.
catalogue_notes: SIMBAD LEDA 147307 (galaxy, 0.5' size) 29.7"; NED WISEA J051735.44-564422.1 ~19". Gaia G=20.4 at 23.6" only. No DR8 photo-z rows within 3" (likely coverage/mask gap). No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
